title: QE pending template UI exposes raw JSON instead of human-readable full configuration editor
description:
Expected: QE pending execution templates must be configurable through a complete human-readable UI equivalent to the QE evolution task creation page. Raw config_json must be removed from the normal operator page and must not be the way to configure all fields.
Actual: /quantevolver/templates/[templateId] exposes only a small subset of structured fields and relies on a large raw JSON textarea for full configuration. This is not readable or operable for manual review.
reproduce_command: Open /quantevolver/templates/{templateId} for a QE pending template and inspect the configuration editor; the full payload is shown as raw JSON instead of complete structured controls.
required_verification: python -m pytest frontend/tests/qe-templates/qe-template-management.spec.ts equivalent Playwright gate via nox qe_template_ui
grep/static guardrail confirms the standard operator page no longer renders a raw config_json textarea as the full editor
closure_requirements: Raw JSON display/editor is removed from the standard QE pending-template operator page
All supported pending task settings are editable through human-readable structured controls
Custom evolution loops can be inspected and edited without editing JSON
Saving updates only qe_execution_templates and does not materialize or execute
Execution still requires validate, approve, materialize, and run confirmation
GitHub issue #113 is updated with fix branch, commit, and validation evidence before closure

events.note: Required fix: remove raw JSON display/editor from the standard operator page.

Required fix: provide structured fields for task/title/description, source experiment/task/loop, model, factors, strategy, strategy params, execution algorithm, execution params, label horizon, data split, node/parallelism, HMM runtime options, ST/PIT/suspend filtering, unfilled handler, custom_evo loops and per-loop settings.
Saving must update only the pending template and must not execute; execution must still require validate/approve/materialize/run.
This is a design compliance defect, not a nice-to-have enhancement, because the approved design requires manual review/edit before execution.
Mirrored manually to GitHub issue #113 because validation MCP live sync is blocked by BOM parse errors in another BUG JSON registry entry.

Fixed in branch bug/BUG-085-qe-pending-template-ui commit eb3eeca; GitHub issue #113 labeled status:fixed-pending-review and commented with validation evidence. Verification: python -m nox -s qe_mcp_l3 -- 8011 3011 passed; qe_mcp_backend 29 passed, qe_archive_backend 106 passed, qe_template_ui TypeScript + Playwright 3 passed; operator page raw JSON editor guardrail rg returned no matches.
